summary: Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) furnished a Form 6-K on September 22, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that founder and CEO Inna Braverman was invited as a Luminary Speaker to the inaugural Futures: Ocean Forum in Newport, Rhode Island on September 24, 2026, with planned discussions with Rhode Island authorities about a potential commercial wave energy project following a U.S. coastline feasibility study with Shell. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural/regulatory mechanic is stated; this is a routine business-development and conference-attendance disclosure, not a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
